name: Josh
bio: I’m a mechanical engineering student at Washington State University. My interest in engines started with fixing lawn mowers. I liked figuring out what was wrong and getting them running again. Then I got my 1989 Toyota pickup, and its truly put me through the ringer.
personal: Working on my truck pushed that interest further and helped lead me toward mechanical engineering. I enjoy hands-on work, from designing and making parts to figuring out how everything fits together. Outside of engineering, I’m into boxing, the gym, and snowboarding.

hobbies.title: Snowboarding
hobbies.text: There's nothing that hits like being on the mountains on a fresh snowy day. When I'm snowboarding, I feel free. All my worries melt away, and the only thing that matters is how much fun I'm having.

projects.title: 1989 Toyota Pickup
projects.description: Swapping the engine, wiring harness, and ECU from a 1999 Toyota 4Runner into my 1989 Toyota pickup.
projects.coverText:
A new heart.
An old Toyota.

projects.title: Carbon snowboard
projects.description: Designing a carbon-fiber snowboard around carving, quick turns, and stability.
